candidate.source: functionally retained candidate supplied to the downstream agent

semantic_frontier.definition: independent non-primary RTL frontier selected from the candidate-to-primary path

parameters.$derived_finite_duration_sweep: bounded campaign parameter inferred from the feature definition and RTL, then frozen before simulation
parameters.$firq_channel: trial parameter inferred and recorded before simulation

symbolic_predicates.$candidate_to_: symbolic condition over the named bound object; underscores delimit words
symbolic_predicates.$primary_follows_MPP_on_both_sides_of_tr: symbolic condition over the named bound object; underscores delimit words

symbolic_predicates.$primary_matches_effective_priv_M: symbolic condition over the named bound object; underscores delimit words

symbolic_predicates.$primary_matches_effective_priv_U: symbolic condition over the named bound object; underscores delimit words

symbolic condition over the named bound object; underscores delimit words

symbolic_predicates.$primary_while_primary_use_event_is_acti: symbolic condition over the named bound object; underscores delimit words

feature_contract.provenance: independent threat definition and RTL semantics; no downstream implementation or result input
feature_contract.trial_parameter_policy: candidate bits, legal values, seeds, repetitions, and bounded timing sweeps are inferred and recorded before simulation; they do not create additional semantic scenarios
feature_contract.definition: Separate transient fault activation and escape from propagation to the primary asset.
feature_contract.execution_model: paired golden and single-candidate-bit faulted executions from the same legal pre-fault state

calculation.fault_injection_feasibility: scenario-balanced fraction of activated faults reaching an independent semantic frontier
calculation.fault_masking: 1 - N_P/N_A, where N_A is valid activated faults and N_P is the subset producing primary divergence

validity_policy: legal golden execution and anchor are reached

classification.no_escape: activated fault does not reach the semantic frontier
classification.escape_masked: fault escapes but primary remains equivalent
classification.escape_propagated: fault escapes and corrupts the primary
classification.not_applicable: candidate lacks the scenario's semantic-use path
classification.invalid: setup, pairing, injection, activation, anchor, or knownness requirement fails

applicability.candidate_scope: candidate with a legal RTL path for this scenario
